description: This file defines the PimReportAPI class in the OrangeHRM project, which extends the ReportAPI to handle specific PIM (Personal Information Management) reports, providing endpoints for report retrieval and validation.

classes.name: PimReportAPI
classes.description: API class for handling PIM reports, extending the base ReportAPI with specific report mapping and validation logic.

methods.name: getReportGeneratorService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the ReportGeneratorService instance used by this API.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves and constructs a specific EndpointAwareReport based on request parameters, validating report name and ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for fetching a single report, ensuring report ID is positive and valid for PIM reports.
